notes: The TCA circle (sv1, pdf 97) is an original KYP redraw preserving the source's eight-metabolite circle with carbon counts, the starred irreversible enzymes (citrate synthase, isocitrate DH, α-KG DH), the product markers (NADH, FADH2, GTP, CO2), and the PDH entry arm. The pyruvate metabolism hub (sv2, pdf 97) reuses the existing pilot registry visual pyruvate-hub (PDH/pyruvate carboxylase/LDH/ALT exits with cofactor handles and the cytosol/mitochondria split), now embedded in this note where the source figure lives — upgraded from the transitional SOURCE_REFERENCE holding state (documented in the worklog). The PDH complex mechanism (sv3, pdf 96) is an original KYP adaptation: the five numbered cofactor cards, reaction bar, activation panel, arsenic panel, and the X-linked deficiency strip.
